claim: Wearables commonly diagnose conditions and support intervention.
originalWording: Wearables commonly diagnose conditions and support intervention.

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Common wearable monitors identify selected acute and chronic problems and trigger useful advice or intervention pathways.
reference.rationale: By late 2018 Apple Watch combined ECG/AFib classification, hard-fall detection and emergency calling; the 2019 wearable survey supports common adoption. Those capabilities satisfy a reasonable targeted-condition reading. The forecast did not demand diagnosis of every disease or removal of physicians.

evidence.title: ECG app and irregular rhythm notification available on Apple Watch
evidence.note: AFib-related features are limited-purpose. The release expressly lists conditions they cannot detect; not general diagnosis or autonomous treatment..
